dashboard.insight1Title: Early Blight Risk Advisory for Solanaceous Crops
dashboard.insight1Desc: High diurnal temperature range combined with overnight relative humidity above 80% creates favorable sporulation conditions. Preventative bio-fungicide (Trichoderma harzianum) recommended.
dashboard.insight2Title: Precision Micro-Irrigation Guidance for Red Soils
dashboard.insight2Desc: Evapotranspiration rates expected to rise by 12% over next 48 hours. Schedule drip cycles between 06:00 and 08:30 AM to conserve water and prevent foliar humidity.
dashboard.insight3Title: NPK Micronutrient Calibration for Vegetative Growth
dashboard.insight3Desc: Maintain balanced nitrogen ratios without excessive urea to avoid soft succulent growth vulnerable to sucking pests and bacterial wilt.
